This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their large size and cylindrical bodies.<ref name="TFA" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|II}}</ref> during the height of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s reign, two members of this species could be found on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]], present at the same time as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s attempt to rescue a young [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Kenobi">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> Later, in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TFA Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a third member of this species was present at [[Takodana Castle]] when the [[First Order]] destroyed the [[Hosnian system]] and invaded the planet [[Takodana]] in search of the [[droid]] [[BB-8]].<ref name="TFA" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[2015]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TFA" />
